note: Adapted from the original German description of Holmgren & Holmgren 1915, published as Calotermes (Cryptotermes) albipes n. sp., type locality Maré Island, Loyalty Islands, collected in a house on 1911-11-17. The original treats only the alate; the soldier and worker are unknown, and the authors note that this species, like the other Cryptotermes, is a house termite. The measurement table is badly garbled in the photocopy - the pronotum width and length columns survive only as gibberish - so only the complete values are cited.

sections.label: Alate
sections.text: Dark brown to black; the anterior margin of the transverse band, the antennal spots, the two spots before the transverse suture, the mesonotum and metanotum and the ventral surface of the abdomen slightly paler; tibiae and tarsi white to yellowish white; wing veins brown-black, the wing membrane transparent, greyish brown. Head with a few short setae; posterior margins of the abdominal tergites with some hairs; wing surface tuberculate. Head oval; compound eyes rather small; ocelli almost touching the compound eye, triangular; cranial sutures almost invisible; postclypeus very short; antennae 14, 15 or 16-segmented, and with 16 segments segments 2, 3 and 4 about equal in length. Pronotum slightly narrower than the head, strongly deflexed at the sides, nearly quadrangular, the anterior corners nearly right-angled, the posterior corners more rounded, the posterior margin concave in the middle. Posterior margin of the metanotum slightly wider than that of the mesonotum, both margins slightly concave. Radius of the forewing short; radial sector with 5—8 anterior branches, the innermost arising at the first quarter of the vein stem; media joining the radial sector at the level of the 4th anterior branch of the radial sector; cubitus with 14—15 branches, only the inner part fully clear. Radius of the hind wing long, extending beyond the inner third of the wing; radial sector with 4—5 anterior branches; media connected to the radial sector between the 2nd and 3rd branches of the radial sector; cubitus as in the forewing. Measurements: head width 0.91 mm (both sexes); forewing length 5.5—6 mm (6.5 mm in the other sex); wing width 1.48—1.67 mm; body length with wings 6.5—7 mm (7.5—8 mm in the other sex); body length without wings 5 mm (6 mm in the other sex).

sections.label: Other
sections.text: Soldier and worker unknown. Type locality Maré Island, Loyalty Islands, collected in a house on 1911-11-17; the original notes that this species, like the other Cryptotermes, is a termite that inhabits houses.
